acceptanceCriteria: One contributor-facing doc explains what the anchor hashes, how to compute it with --hash, and that the doc checks read the index.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from agent friction. Line-citation anchors `path:N-M@hex` hash the content of the cited lines, and `script/check-line-citations.sh --hash path:N-M` prints the expected anchor. The check reads the git index, not the worktree, so edits must be staged before it runs. None of this is written down. Agents kept rediscovering it while repinning citations after BUILD-LOG line shifts.
